nodes.title: SG-3.1 · Create the missing top-level App component
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/main.tsx imports './App', but App.tsx does not exist. The pieces already exist: useGame, IntroScreen, SceneView, ActionMenu, StoryPanel and GameLayout. Desired behavior: App uses useGame to show IntroScreen first, then SceneView, ActionMenu and StoryPanel inside GameLayout. Expected result: the entry point compiles and the opening bedroom scene can be played. Why: this is the missing top-level piece for the playable 80/20 frontend.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the app starts, when App renders, then the intro copy and a Begin button are shown and no scene hotspots are present
- Given the intro is shown, when Begin is clicked, then the bedroom scene with hotspot buttons, the story panel with the boy's opening dialogue, and the Story drawer toggle are rendered
- Given the scene is shown, when a hotspot is clicked and an action button is pressed, then the game state changes and the result appears in the story history


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/App.tsx composing existing components with useGame
- Out of scope: Community contribution UI
- Out of scope: Backend APIs
- Out of scope: Changes to existing components, useGame or the engine
- Preserve: main.tsx import of './App' as default export
- Preserve: GameLayout, useGame and component props as they are


## Technical constraints
- React 18 + TypeScript; default export App
- Reuse components in game/frontend/src/components and useGame from src/runtime/useGame.ts
- Use getActiveNode from @game/systems/dialogue (alias already configured)


## Definition of done
- App.tsx exists and tsc --noEmit passes
- Opening scene is playable through intro, hotspot, action and dialogue choice


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · App shows the intro screen before gameplay
nodes.body:
Context: IntroScreen takes an onBegin prop and main.tsx needs a default-exported App. Desired behavior: App keeps a begun flag, false at start; while false it renders only IntroScreen. Expected result: the player sees the intro copy first and the entry point compiles. Why: the opening experience begins with the boy's question.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a fresh App render, then the text 'What should I do?' and a Begin button are visible
- Given a fresh App render, then no hotspot buttons are rendered


## Scope
- In scope: Default-exported App with intro gate
- Out of scope: Playing view composition
- Preserve: IntroScreen props and copy


## Technical constraints
- useState for the begun flag; no new dependencies


## Definition of done
- App.tsx default-exports a component that renders IntroScreen first


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · After Begin, App composes the playable 80/20 game view
nodes.body:
Context: useGame returns state, scene, view, act, choose; SceneView takes sceneId/title/objects/selectedId/onSelect; ActionMenu takes object/onAction; StoryPanel takes node/history/inventory/onChoose. Desired behavior: after Begin, App renders GameLayout with the scene (SceneView plus ActionMenu for the selected object) and the story (StoryPanel). Expected result: clicking a hotspot opens its actions, performing an action updates history/flags, and dialogue choices work. Why: makes the opening scene playable.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the intro was dismissed, then the bedroom background image, six hotspots and the Story toggle are rendered and the dialogue shows "I don't know what to do next. What should we do?"
- Given the game view, when the Bookshelf hotspot is clicked, then the Bookshelf action menu with Inspect, Push, Search and Leave buttons appears
- Given the Bookshelf menu, when Search is clicked, then the history list contains 'A hidden door swings open behind the books.' and the bookshelf hotspot has data-open true
- Given the opening dialogue, when the choice 'Look around the room' is clicked, then the dialogue section disappears and the history contains that text


## Scope
- In scope: Playing view in App.tsx with selected-object state
- Out of scope: Contribution UI
- Out of scope: Restyling
- Preserve: Intro gate behavior from R1


## Technical constraints
- Selected object id kept in App useState; selected object found from game.view
- Active node via getActiveNode(game.state, game.scene)


## Dependencies
- R1


## Definition of done
- Playing view wired to useGame and existing components


## Clarifying questions
- None
